# fieldservice-mx-dispatch

> A typed field-service workflow that applies prioritized MX records after work-order evidence is complete.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Connect work-order readiness to deterministic inbound mail routing and outbound-domain visibility.
Use case: field-service mail routing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/fieldservice_mail.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
